prereg.status: DRAFT - lock (set status to LOCKED with a date) before the confirmatory Part II run
prereg.unit: dataset draw: a full benchmark-construction replicate (hospital data, mask, estimated benchmark, user data) for Gumbel / Garnet; a user-dataset replicate for ICU-Sepsis. Learners are deterministic given data.
prereg.deployment_target: true dynamics where available (Gumbel, Garnet); terminate rule for ICU-Sepsis (no ground truth)
prereg.normalized_score: (J - J_behaviour) / (J*_target - J_behaviour) per (cell, draw, target); J* is the target's optimum
prereg.default_policy_set: every method at its *_default hyper-parameters, variants native / masked / projected

H1_benchmark_fidelity.question: Does the completion rule for unsupported actions (mean imputation vs termination) change how faithfully ICU-style benchmark rankings reproduce true-system rankings?
H1_benchmark_fidelity.metric: Kendall tau-b between benchmark values and true values over the default policy set, per draw; a benchmark that assigns every policy the same value scores tau = 0 (no ranking information); such draws are counted and reported
H1_benchmark_fidelity.test: two-sided sign-flip on per-draw differences tau(mean) - tau(terminate) within each Gumbel estimated-benchmark cell (construction 'best'); Holm across cells

H2_projection_sufficiency.question: Does any learned constraint-aware method improve the deployment value over the admissible projection of tabular IQL?
H2_projection_sufficiency.test: two-sided sign-flip on paired differences within each environment family (ICU, Gumbel, Garnet; ICU/Gumbel: (cell, draw) units pooled across cells (independent streams); Garnet: one unit per base-MDP draw (mean over the harm x eps cells that share it); intervals resample Garnet draws jointly across cells); Holm over treatments x families; TOST with the declared margin on the same units

H3_harm_moderates_error.question: Does the benchmark error of mean imputation grow with the harm |h| of unsupported actions (Garnet)?
H3_harm_moderates_error.metric: mean |J_true - J_bench_mean| over the default policy set, per draw
H3_harm_moderates_error.test: Spearman correlation between |h| and the per-draw error, two-sided permutation p-value: permutation of |h| within (eps, draw) blocks, 10 000 permutations (h = -0.5 kept as a beneficial-unsupported control)

exploratory: exact tabular vs SGD (Part I) agreement

analysis.H1: sign-flip per cell on all draws (constant-benchmark draws score tau = 0); Holm across cells
analysis.H2: ICU / Gumbel: (cell, draw) units pooled; Garnet: blocked by draw (mean over its cells), bootstrap resamples Garnet draws jointly across cells
analysis.H3: permutation of |h| within (eps, draw) blocks, 10 000 permutations
analysis.sign_flip: exact enumeration for n <= 16; Monte Carlo with 200 000 sign patterns (+1 correction) otherwise

warning: PREREG_PART2 is not locked: these tests are exploratory until the preregistration is locked before the confirmatory run.

H1.metric: Kendall tau-b, bench vs true, default policy set
H1.constant_benchmark: a benchmark that gives every policy the same value scores tau = 0 (Kendall tau-a, no ranking information); such draws stay in the primary test and are counted (n_benchmark_constant); p_value_excluding_constant_benchmarks drops them

test_units.garnet: draw block (mean over the cells sharing a base MDP)

descriptive_mask_and_violations.note: the harm changes the mask itself, so H3 mixes the size of the harm with the number of unsupported actions; the per-violation ratios (ratio of means over draws) separate the two
